roadmap.title: Protect the one-save route
roadmap.description: Start a default Freeplay map with Space Age enabled. Keep every achievement-disabling enemy and pollution setting at an allowed value, place no forbidden logistic chests, solar panels, or laser turrets, destroy no spawners, and meet the 90-minute locomotive deadline.

roadmap.title: Launch the first rocket
roadmap.description: Keep manual crafting at 111 or lower, reach artillery before destroying the first spawner, build the base-game factory, and launch within eight hours without solar panels or laser turrets.

roadmap.title: Establish the first planets
roadmap.description: Create a space platform, visit Vulcanus, Fulgora, and Gleba, and consume a planetary science pack before unlocking production or utility science. After Rush to space and Logistic network embargo register, normal science and logistics are unrestricted.

roadmap.title: Finish Space Age
roadmap.description: Use all three planetary science chains to reach Aquilo, build fusion and late-quality systems, reach the solar system edge within 40 hours, and continue at least 60,000 km toward the shattered planet for promethium research.

roadmap.title: Complete postgame cleanup
roadmap.description: Use the finished factory for cumulative production, robot, combat, vehicle, technology, and rate achievements. Preserve long-running production while cleaning up the remaining counters.

achievements.description: Deconstruct 100 objects with the construction robots.
achievements.summary: Have construction robots deconstruct 100 placed objects or tiles.

guide.context: Unlike robot construction, deconstruction credit includes marked tiles as well as structures.

steps.text: Inside a supplied roboport network, use a deconstruction planner on at least 100 structures or tiles and let construction robots remove every marked object.

achievements.description: Construct 100 machines using robots.
achievements.summary: Have construction robots place 100 machines or structures from construction ghosts.

guide.context: Belts and many ordinary structures count as machines, but placed tiles do not count toward this construction total.

steps.text: Supply a powered roboport network with construction robots and materials, place a blueprint containing at least 100 belts or machines, and let robots finish the placements.

achievements.description: Produce 1.0k advanced circuits per hour.
achievements.summary: Produce at least @item{1,000 advanced circuits} during one rolling 60-minute production window.

guide.context: The rate must be sustained as actual completed output during the hour; a momentary rate shown by the production graph does not satisfy the counter.

steps.text: Build enough automated advanced circuits production, keep every output running and unblocked, and maintain at least 1,000 completed units during one 60-minute window.

achievements.description: Produce 10k advanced circuits per hour.
achievements.summary: Produce at least @item{10,000 advanced circuits} during one rolling 60-minute production window.

guide.context: The rate must be sustained as actual completed output during the hour; a momentary rate shown by the production graph does not satisfy the counter.

steps.text: Build enough automated advanced circuits production, keep every output running and unblocked, and maintain at least 10,000 completed units during one 60-minute window.

achievements.description: Produce 25k advanced circuits per hour.
achievements.summary: Produce at least @item{25,000 advanced circuits} during one rolling 60-minute production window.

guide.context: The rate must be sustained as actual completed output during the hour; a momentary rate shown by the production graph does not satisfy the counter.

steps.text: Build enough automated advanced circuits production, keep every output running and unblocked, and maintain at least 25,000 completed units during one 60-minute window.

achievements.description: Produce 500 processing units per hour.
achievements.summary: Produce at least @item{500 processing units} during one rolling 60-minute production window.

guide.context: The rate must be sustained as actual completed output during the hour; a momentary rate shown by the production graph does not satisfy the counter.

steps.text: Build enough automated processing units production, keep every output running and unblocked, and maintain at least 500 completed units during one 60-minute window.

achievements.description: Produce 1.0k processing units per hour.
achievements.summary: Produce at least @item{1,000 processing units} during one rolling 60-minute production window.

guide.context: The rate must be sustained as actual completed output during the hour; a momentary rate shown by the production graph does not satisfy the counter.

steps.text: Build enough automated processing units production, keep every output running and unblocked, and maintain at least 1,000 completed units during one 60-minute window.

achievements.description: Produce 5k processing units per hour.
achievements.summary: Produce at least @item{5,000 processing units} during one rolling 60-minute production window.

guide.context: The rate must be sustained as actual completed output during the hour; a momentary rate shown by the production graph does not satisfy the counter.

steps.text: Build enough automated processing units production, keep every output running and unblocked, and maintain at least 5,000 completed units during one 60-minute window.

achievements.description: Supply the character by logistic robot.
achievements.summary: Receive at least one requested inventory item from a @npc{logistic robot}.

guide.context: The character must stand inside logistic-network coverage and the requested item must exist in an accessible provider or storage chest.

steps.text: Set a personal logistic request, place the requested item in network storage, and remain in logistic range until a logistic robot deposits the item in the character inventory.

achievements.description: Supply the character with 10k items delivered by logistic robots.
achievements.summary: Receive a cumulative total of 10,000 inventory items from @npc{logistic robots}.

guide.context: Personal logistic deliveries accumulate over time; raising and lowering a high-volume request can deliberately move bulk materials.

steps.text: Inside a stocked logistic network, request a large stack of iron plates or another abundant material, return delivered stacks to storage, and continue deliveries until the counter reaches 10,000.

achievements.description: Research oil processing.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Oil processing} technology.

guide.context: Oil processing uses automation and logistic science packs and is part of normal rocket progression.

steps.text: Supply working labs with automation and logistic science packs and finish researching Oil processing.

achievements.description: Build a locomotive.
achievements.summary: Place a crafted @item{locomotive} on a rail.

guide.context: Railway research unlocks both the locomotive and rails, and the trigger occurs only when the locomotive is placed.

steps.text: Research Railway, craft at least one rail and one locomotive, place the rail, and place the locomotive on that rail.

achievements.displayName: Getting on track like a pro
achievements.description: Build a locomotive within the first 90 minutes of the game.
achievements.summary: Place a @item{locomotive} on rails before the save timer reaches 90 minutes.

guide.context: The locomotive must be placed on a rail; crafting the locomotive without placement does not count.

steps.text: On a fresh Freeplay save, research Railway, craft rails and one locomotive, place the rails, and place the locomotive before 01:30:00.

achievements.description: Survive a hit of 500 damage or more.
achievements.summary: Survive a single hit that deals at least 500 damage.

guide.context: A fast locomotive supplies the required impact, while charged Energy Shield MK2 equipment can absorb enough damage for survival.

steps.text: Equip powered armor with several fully charged Energy Shield MK2 units, save the game, and stand farther along a locomotive's acceleration path until one impact exceeds 500 damage without killing the character.

achievements.description: Produce 20k iron plates per hour.
achievements.summary: Produce at least @item{20,000 iron plates} during one rolling 60-minute production window.

guide.context: The rate must be sustained as actual completed output during the hour; a momentary rate shown by the production graph does not satisfy the counter.

steps.text: Build enough automated iron plates production, keep every output running and unblocked, and maintain at least 20,000 completed units during one 60-minute window.

achievements.description: Produce 200k iron plates per hour.
achievements.summary: Produce at least @item{200,000 iron plates} during one rolling 60-minute production window.

guide.context: The rate must be sustained as actual completed output during the hour; a momentary rate shown by the production graph does not satisfy the counter.

steps.text: Build enough automated iron plates production, keep every output running and unblocked, and maintain at least 200,000 completed units during one 60-minute window.

achievements.description: Produce 400k iron plates per hour.
achievements.summary: Produce at least @item{400,000 iron plates} during one rolling 60-minute production window.

guide.context: The rate must be sustained as actual completed output during the hour; a momentary rate shown by the production graph does not satisfy the counter.

steps.text: Build enough automated iron plates production, keep every output running and unblocked, and maintain at least 400,000 completed units during one 60-minute window.

achievements.displayName: It stinks and they don't like it
achievements.description: Trigger an alien attack by pollution.
achievements.summary: Let Nauvis pollution reach an enemy nest and trigger a biter attack group.

guide.context: Peaceful mode, no enemies, and disabled pollution prevent this trigger. For saves started on version 2.0.45 or later, keep pollution and every enemy-related map setting—including enemy-base frequency and size, expansion, starting area, and trees—at default or harder; version 2.0.46 does not apply these new limits retroactively to older saves.

steps.text: Keep a polluting factory operating near a biter base until the pollution cloud reaches the nest and consumes pollution to form an attack group.

achievements.description: Launch a rocket to space while manually crafting no more than 111 items.
achievements.summary: Launch a rocket after manually crafting no more than 111 total items in the save.

guide.context: The manual-craft counter is shared by every player in multiplayer. A route using the starting stone furnace can reach Automation in about 101 crafts, leaving only a small margin.

steps.text: Handcraft only the minimum power, lab, ten automation science packs, and assembling machine 1 setup; pin the achievement counter, automate every later component, and launch a rocket while the counter remains at 111 or lower.

achievements.description: Finish research with space science pack for the base game or any planetary science pack for Space Age without building any active provider, buffer, or requester chests.
achievements.summary: Finish research using a planetary science pack without ever placing an @item{active provider chest}, @item{buffer chest}, or @item{requester chest}.

guide.context: Passive provider and storage chests are allowed, and crafting a forbidden chest is harmless until the chest is placed. In the base game, the alternative trigger uses space science.

steps.text: Leave all active provider, buffer, and requester chests unplaced; obtain a planetary science pack; then finish one technology that consumes that pack.

achievements.description: Produce 10k electronic circuits.
achievements.summary: Produce a cumulative total of @item{10,000 electronic circuits} across achievement-enabled saves.

guide.context: The production counter persists across different maps, so earlier factory output remains credited toward the total.

steps.text: Keep automated electronic circuits production consuming its output until the cumulative achievement counter reaches 10,000.

achievements.description: Produce 1M electronic circuits.
achievements.summary: Produce a cumulative total of @item{1 million electronic circuits} across achievement-enabled saves.

guide.context: The production counter persists across different maps, so earlier factory output remains credited toward the total.

steps.text: Keep automated electronic circuits production consuming its output until the cumulative achievement counter reaches 1 million.

achievements.description: Produce 20M electronic circuits.
achievements.summary: Produce a cumulative total of @item{20 million electronic circuits} across achievement-enabled saves.

guide.context: The production counter persists across different maps, so earlier factory output remains credited toward the total.

steps.text: Keep automated electronic circuits production consuming its output until the cumulative achievement counter reaches 20 million.

achievements.description: Have 100 combat robots or more following you.
achievements.summary: Have at least 100 active @npc{combat robots} following the character at the same time.

guide.context: Construction and logistic robots do not count. Follower robot count level 7 provides capacity for 100 combat robots, and capsule robots expire after a limited duration.

steps.text: Research follower robot count through level 7, prepare enough defender or destroyer capsules for 100 robots, and deploy every capsule quickly enough for all 100 combat robots to coexist.

achievements.displayName: Smoke me a kipper, I'll be back for breakfast
achievements.description: Launch a rocket to space.
achievements.summary: Build a rocket silo, complete a rocket, and launch the rocket into space.

guide.context: The base-game completion trigger occurs when the launched rocket leaves the screen; the Freeplay save remains playable afterward.

steps.text: Research Rocket silo, place a silo, supply enough ingredients for all rocket parts, and press Launch after the rocket is ready.

achievements.description: Launch a rocket to space within 15 hours.
achievements.summary: Launch a rocket before the save timer reaches 15 hours.

guide.context: This deadline uses the Freeplay save timer. For saves started on version 2.0.45 or later, keep pollution and every enemy-related map setting—including enemy-base frequency and size, expansion, starting area, and trees—at default or harder; version 2.0.46 does not apply these new limits retroactively to older saves.

steps.text: Use a prepared bus, science, smelting, and rocket blueprint route; research Rocket silo, complete the rocket, and launch before 15:00:00.

achievements.description: Launch a rocket to space within 8 hours.
achievements.summary: Launch a rocket before the save timer reaches 8 hours.

guide.context: Finish a normal game first and prepare blueprints plus a known map seed. For saves started on version 2.0.45 or later, keep pollution and every enemy-related map setting—including enemy-base frequency and size, expansion, starting area, and trees—at default or harder; version 2.0.46 does not apply these new limits retroactively to older saves.

steps.text: On a Freeplay save that follows the stated version 2.0.45+ map-setting rule, continuously expand mining, smelting, science, and rocket-part production; finish Rocket silo research and launch before 08:00:00.

achievements.description: Destroy 10k trees with fire.
achievements.summary: Destroy a cumulative total of 10,000 trees or Gleba plants with fire.

guide.context: Burning a large forest produces heavy pollution and can spread widely; Gleba plants also count as trees.

steps.text: Save before cleanup, carry a fueled flamethrower, ignite dense forests or Gleba vegetation, and let the fire destroy plants until the counter reaches 10,000.

achievements.description: Launch a rocket to space without building any laser turrets.
achievements.summary: Launch a rocket without placing any @item{laser turret} in the save.

guide.context: Crafting laser turrets is allowed; only placement breaks the condition. Gun turrets, flamethrower turrets, mines, and personal weapons remain available. For saves started on version 2.0.45 or later, keep pollution and every enemy-related map setting—including enemy-base frequency and size, expansion, starting area, and trees—at default or harder; version 2.0.46 does not apply these new limits retroactively to older saves.

steps.text: Defend the factory without placing laser turrets and launch a rocket.

achievements.description: Destroy 100 trees by impact.
achievements.summary: Destroy 100 trees by hitting the trees with a moving @item{car} or @item{tank}.

guide.context: The tank loses less speed and durability per collision, making a dense forest the efficient cleanup location.

steps.text: Drive a repaired tank through dense forest and keep colliding with standing trees until 100 impact destructions register.

achievements.description: Produce more than 10 GJ per hour using only solar panels.
achievements.summary: Produce more than 10 GJ during one hour on an electric network powered only by @item{solar panels}.

guide.context: The isolated network must consume or store the generated energy. On Nauvis, 67 panels theoretically exceed the 2.778 MW average needed, while extra panels provide margin.

steps.text: Build at least 67 solar panels with accumulators and a steady electrical load on a network disconnected from every steam engine, steam turbine, and fusion generator; keep the network active for a full hour.

achievements.displayName: So long and thanks for all the fish
achievements.description: Launch a rocket with a raw fish as its cargo.
achievements.summary: Place one @item{raw fish} in a completed rocket's cargo slot and launch the rocket.

guide.context: Raw fish can be collected from water by mining the fish. Saving before launch lets the same rocket resources be reused after the achievement registers.

steps.text: Mine one raw fish from water, insert the fish into the rocket cargo slot, and launch the completed rocket.

achievements.description: Launch a rocket to space without building any solar panels.
achievements.summary: Launch a rocket without placing any @item{solar panel} in the save.

guide.context: Crafting solar panels is allowed; only placing a panel breaks the condition. For saves started on version 2.0.45 or later, keep pollution and every enemy-related map setting—including enemy-base frequency and size, expansion, starting area, and trees—at default or harder; version 2.0.46 does not apply these new limits retroactively to older saves.

steps.text: Use steam or nuclear power through the first launch, keep every solar panel unplaced, and launch a rocket.

achievements.description: Destroy 10 spawners by impact.
achievements.summary: Destroy 10 enemy spawners by driving a @item{car} or @item{tank} into the spawners.

guide.context: Spawner health rises with evolution, and the tank survives impacts better than the car.

steps.text: After Keeping your hands clean is complete, weaken spawners without destroying the nests, then drive a tank into each nest for the final damage until 10 impact kills register.

achievements.description: Research all technologies.
achievements.summary: Research every finite technology and every finite level that precedes an infinite technology.

guide.context: Infinite repetitions are unnecessary, but all non-infinite levels must be finished. The completion condition is evaluated when any technology finishes.

steps.text: Clear every remaining finite entry and finite prerequisite level from the technology tree, then complete one final technology to trigger the all-research check.

achievements.description: Have a train plan a path 1,000 tiles or longer.
achievements.summary: Give a train an automatically planned route at least 1,000 tiles long.

guide.context: The measurement follows the train's planned rail path rather than straight-line distance.

steps.text: Build a connected rail route longer than 1,000 tiles, place stations near both ends, assign both stations to a train schedule, and let the train calculate the long path.

achievements.description: Get killed by a moving locomotive.
achievements.summary: Let a moving @item{locomotive} strike and kill the player character.

guide.context: Save first because the trigger requires death rather than merely taking train damage.

steps.text: Place a locomotive on a powered route, stand on the rail ahead of the moving train without protective shields, and remain in place until the impact kills the character.

achievements.description: Construct more machines using robots than manually.
achievements.summary: Raise the save's robot-built machine count above the manually placed machine count.

guide.context: Belts count as machines, so a dense belt blueprint provides fast robot-build credit even after extensive manual construction.

steps.text: Create a large belt-grid blueprint, have construction robots place the complete grid, deconstruct the grid, and place the blueprint again until robot-built machines exceed manual placements.

achievements.description: Build a spidertron.
achievements.summary: Craft a @item{spidertron} and place the spidertron in the world.

guide.context: Crafting alone does not trigger the achievement; the completed endgame vehicle must be deployed.

steps.text: Research Spidertron, craft the vehicle, select the spidertron from inventory, and place the vehicle on open ground.

achievements.description: Destroy an enemy structure using artillery.
achievements.summary: Destroy an enemy structure with an @item{artillery turret} or @item{artillery wagon}.

guide.context: If artillery delivers the save's first spawner or egg-raft kill, that same destruction can satisfy both Art of siege and Keeping your hands clean.

steps.text: Place and load an artillery turret or wagon so an existing enemy structure is within range, then allow the artillery shell to destroy the structure.

achievements.description: Build an assembling machine.
achievements.summary: Place an @item{assembling machine 1} in the world.

guide.context: Placing an assembling machine 2 before ever placing assembling machine 1 does not trigger this achievement.

steps.text: Research @mechanic{Automation}, craft an assembling machine 1, and place the machine on the ground.

achievements.description: Craft an efficiency module 3.
achievements.summary: Craft one @item{efficiency module 3}.

guide.context: The achievement checks the completed module craft, whether the recipe is performed by the character or an assembling machine.

steps.text: Research Efficiency module 3, supply the recipe's lower-tier modules and processing units, and finish crafting one efficiency module 3.

achievements.description: Craft a productivity module 3.
achievements.summary: Craft one @item{productivity module 3}.

guide.context: The achievement checks the completed module craft, whether the recipe is performed by the character or an assembling machine.

steps.text: Research Productivity module 3, supply the recipe's lower-tier modules and processing units, and finish crafting one productivity module 3.

achievements.description: Craft a quality module 3.
achievements.summary: Craft one @item{quality module 3}.

guide.context: Quality module 3 requires the later quality-module technology and lower-tier quality modules.

steps.text: Research Quality module 3, supply the lower-tier modules and ingredients, and complete one quality module 3 craft.

achievements.description: Craft a speed module 3.
achievements.summary: Craft one @item{speed module 3}.

guide.context: The achievement checks the completed module craft, whether the recipe is performed by the character or an assembling machine.

steps.text: Research Speed module 3, supply the recipe's lower-tier modules and processing units, and finish crafting one speed module 3.

achievements.displayName: I am the destroyer of worlds
achievements.description: Use an atomic bomb.
achievements.summary: Fire one @item{atomic bomb} from a rocket launcher.

guide.context: Atomic bombs are late-game ammunition and require uranium processing plus the Atomic bomb technology.

steps.text: Research Atomic bomb, craft one atomic bomb and a rocket launcher, equip the launcher, select the atomic bomb ammunition, and fire at a safe distant target.

achievements.description: Finish the game within 40 hours.
achievements.summary: Reach the @loc{solar system edge} before the save timer reaches 40 hours.

guide.context: The timer includes all planetary setup and travel, and prepared factory and platform blueprints reduce planning time. For saves started on version 2.0.45 or later, keep pollution and every enemy-related map setting—including enemy-base frequency and size, expansion, starting area, and trees—at default or harder; version 2.0.46 does not apply these new limits retroactively to older saves.

steps.text: Use a rehearsed route with minimal planetary bases, produce only the science needed for Aquilo and edge travel, and reach the solar system edge before 40:00:00.

achievements.description: Start producing electric power by fusion powerplant.
achievements.summary: Fuel a @item{fusion generator} through a working fusion reactor and let the generator produce electricity.

guide.context: Fusion power becomes available through late Aquilo progression; merely placing the power-plant structures does not satisfy the electricity-production trigger.

steps.text: Research fusion power, build a fusion power plant, connect an electrical load, and operate the plant until the fusion generator produces electricity.

achievements.description: Disturb a demolisher by building on its territory.
achievements.summary: Place a structure inside a marked @enemy{demolisher territory} on Vulcanus and provoke the resident demolisher.

guide.context: The territories appear as marked regions outside the starting area. Peaceful mode and no enemies prevent this trigger. For saves started on version 2.0.45 or later, keep pollution and every enemy-related map setting—including enemy-base frequency and size, expansion, starting area, and trees—at default or harder; version 2.0.46 does not apply these new limits retroactively to older saves.

steps.text: Enter a marked demolisher territory on Vulcanus, place a mining drill or another structure inside the boundary, and wait until the resident demolisher reacts.

achievements.displayName: If it bleeds, we can kill it
achievements.description: Kill a small demolisher.
achievements.summary: Kill one small @enemy{demolisher} in a territory near the Vulcanus starting area.

guide.context: Demolishers resist explosive damage; non-explosive uranium tank shells and head or tail hits are effective against a small target.

steps.text: Upgrade physical projectile damage, load a tank with uranium cannon shells, attack a small demolisher's head or tail, and keep firing until the demolisher dies.

achievements.displayName: It stinks and they do like it
achievements.description: Attract a group of pentapods using spores.
achievements.summary: Generate enough Gleba spores to attract and launch a @enemy{pentapod} attack group.

guide.context: Fruit processing releases spores like Nauvis pollution. Peaceful mode, no enemies, and disabled pollution prevent this trigger. For saves started on version 2.0.45 or later, keep pollution and every enemy-related map setting—including enemy-base frequency and size, expansion, starting area, and trees—at default or harder; version 2.0.46 does not apply these new limits retroactively to older saves.

steps.text: Operate fruit-processing and agricultural production on Gleba until the spore cloud reaches an egg raft and causes a pentapod attack group to form.

achievements.description: Destroy your first enemy structure using artillery.
achievements.summary: Make the first destroyed enemy spawner or Gleba egg raft in the save die to @item{artillery}.

guide.context: Destroying any spawner or egg raft by another method permanently blocks the achievement in that save. Nauvis worms may be killed, and surrounding a spawner with structures can suppress spawning without destroying the nest. For saves started on version 2.0.45 or later, keep pollution and every enemy-related map setting—including enemy-base frequency and size, expansion, starting area, and trees—at default or harder; version 2.0.46 does not apply these new limits retroactively to older saves.

steps.text: Avoid destroying every biter spawner and egg raft, research artillery, place and load an artillery turret or wagon, and let artillery destroy the save's first spawner or egg raft.

achievements.displayName: Look at my shiny rare armor
achievements.description: Equip rare or better quality of power armor MK2 or mech armor.
achievements.summary: Equip a rare, epic, or legendary @item{power armor MK2} or @item{mech armor}.

guide.context: The armor quality must be rare or better; high-quality equipment inside normal-quality armor does not satisfy the requirement.

steps.text: Produce power armor MK2 or mech armor at rare quality or better, move the armor into the character armor slot, and close the inventory.

achievements.description: Manually insert a quality module into a module slot.
achievements.summary: Manually insert one @item{quality module} into a compatible machine's module slot.

guide.context: The trigger requires a manual insertion into a module slot; merely crafting or transporting the module does not count.

steps.text: Craft a quality module 1, open a compatible machine, pick up the module, and place the module into an empty module slot.

achievements.description: Completely deplete a resource patch.
achievements.summary: Mine the final resource tile in a patch so no matching ore tile remains within 12 tiles.

guide.context: The game checks nearby tiles whenever one resource tile is exhausted; small starting-area patches shorten the cleanup.

steps.text: Cover every tile of a small coal, stone, iron, or copper patch with mining drills and keep outputs clear until the final nearby resource tile is depleted.

achievements.description: Craft a legendary quality module 3.
achievements.summary: Craft one legendary-quality @item{quality module 3}.

guide.context: Legendary quality requires Aquilo research. Recycling lower-quality quality modules back into ingredients creates an upcycling loop that improves the odds over time.

steps.text: Unlock Legendary quality, install the best available quality modules in quality-module production and recyclers, recycle every non-legendary output, and continue the loop until one legendary quality module 3 is crafted.

achievements.description: Fill every tile of legendary mech armor with legendary equipment.
achievements.summary: Equip legendary @item{mech armor} and fill every one of its 255 equipment-grid tiles with legendary equipment.

guide.context: A legendary mech armor grid is 15 by 17. Any combination of legendary equipment counts when the grid has no empty tile.

steps.text: Craft legendary mech armor, mass-produce compact legendary equipment such as energy shields and belt-immunity equipment, equip the armor, and pack the 15-by-17 grid without leaving any empty tile.

achievements.description: Start producing electric power by nuclear powerplant.
achievements.summary: Consume a uranium fuel cell, produce a used-up uranium fuel cell, and let a @item{steam turbine} generate electricity.

guide.context: The three checks can occur in separate systems; the turbine does not need to use steam heated by the same reactor.

steps.text: Run a fueled nuclear reactor until one uranium fuel cell becomes a used-up uranium fuel cell, then supply a connected steam turbine with steam and an electrical load so the turbine produces power.

achievements.description: Destroy a biter spawner.
achievements.summary: Destroy one @enemy{biter spawner} on Nauvis.

guide.context: Delay every spawner and Gleba egg-raft destruction until Keeping your hands clean has unlocked; Nauvis worms may be killed safely.

steps.text: After Keeping your hands clean has unlocked, attack and destroy any circular biter spawner.

achievements.description: Create a space platform.
achievements.summary: Create and deploy a @item{space platform starter pack} to establish a space platform.

guide.context: Space platforms provide orbital production and transport between planets; construction continues remotely through the platform hub.

steps.text: Research Space platform, craft a space platform starter pack, open the space map, choose Create space platform, and launch the starter pack to the new platform.

achievements.description: Research a technology using agricultural science packs.
achievements.summary: Complete any technology whose research cost includes @item{agricultural science packs}.

guide.context: Agricultural science is manufactured on Gleba and must be handled before spoilage removes stored packs.

steps.text: Automate agricultural science packs, place the packs in working labs, and finish one technology that consumes that science-pack type.

achievements.description: Research a technology using automation science packs.
achievements.summary: Complete any technology whose research cost includes @item{automation science packs}.

guide.context: Automation science is the first research tier and is manufactured from copper plates and iron gears.

steps.text: Automate automation science packs, place the packs in working labs, and finish one technology that consumes that science-pack type.

achievements.description: Research a technology using chemical science packs.
achievements.summary: Complete any technology whose research cost includes @item{chemical science packs}.

guide.context: Chemical science requires the oil-processing chain and opens the middle of the technology tree.

steps.text: Automate chemical science packs, place the packs in working labs, and finish one technology that consumes that science-pack type.

achievements.description: Research a technology using cryogenic science packs.
achievements.summary: Complete any technology whose research cost includes @item{cryogenic science packs}.

guide.context: Cryogenic science is manufactured on Aquilo after establishing heat and resource production on the frozen planet.

steps.text: Automate cryogenic science packs, place the packs in working labs, and finish one technology that consumes that science-pack type.

achievements.description: Research a technology using electromagnetic science packs.
achievements.summary: Complete any technology whose research cost includes @item{electromagnetic science packs}.

guide.context: Electromagnetic science is manufactured on Fulgora from the planet's recycling and electromagnetic production chain.

steps.text: Automate electromagnetic science packs, place the packs in working labs, and finish one technology that consumes that science-pack type.

achievements.description: Research a technology using logistic science packs.
achievements.summary: Complete any technology whose research cost includes @item{logistic science packs}.

guide.context: Logistic science follows Automation and expands the early transport and production technology tree.

steps.text: Automate logistic science packs, place the packs in working labs, and finish one technology that consumes that science-pack type.

achievements.description: Research a technology using metallurgic science packs.
achievements.summary: Complete any technology whose research cost includes @item{metallurgic science packs}.

guide.context: Metallurgic science is manufactured on Vulcanus and can serve as the first off-world pack for Rush to space.

steps.text: Automate metallurgic science packs, place the packs in working labs, and finish one technology that consumes that science-pack type.

achievements.description: Research a technology using military science packs.
achievements.summary: Complete any technology whose research cost includes @item{military science packs}.

guide.context: Military science can be pursued before oil processing and supports the defenses needed by the protected route.

steps.text: Automate military science packs, place the packs in working labs, and finish one technology that consumes that science-pack type.

achievements.description: Research a technology using production science packs.
achievements.summary: Complete any technology whose research cost includes @item{production science packs}.

guide.context: Production science must remain locked until Rush to space is complete on the one-save route.

steps.text: Automate production science packs, place the packs in working labs, and finish one technology that consumes that science-pack type.

achievements.description: Research a technology using space science packs.
achievements.summary: Complete any technology whose research cost includes @item{space science packs}.

guide.context: In Space Age, space science is manufactured on a space platform from asteroid-derived materials.

steps.text: Automate space science packs, place the packs in working labs, and finish one technology that consumes that science-pack type.

achievements.description: Research a technology using utility science packs.
achievements.summary: Complete any technology whose research cost includes @item{utility science packs}.

guide.context: Utility science must remain locked until Rush to space is complete on the one-save route.

steps.text: Automate utility science packs, place the packs in working labs, and finish one technology that consumes that science-pack type.

achievements.description: Research a technology using another planet's science pack before unlocking production or utility science packs.
achievements.summary: Use a science pack from another planet to finish research before completing @mechanic{Production science} or @mechanic{Utility science}.

guide.context: The lockout occurs when Production science or Utility science itself finishes, not when a later technology consumes those packs.

steps.text: Keep Production science and Utility science unfinished, launch a space platform, reach Vulcanus, Fulgora, or Gleba, import that planet's science packs, and complete a technology using the planetary packs first.

achievements.displayName: Second star to the right and straight on till morning
achievements.description: Finish the game.
achievements.summary: Travel 100,000 km from Aquilo to the @loc{solar system edge} on a surviving space platform.

guide.context: Reaching the solar system edge is the Space Age completion trigger and leaves the save available for postgame travel toward the shattered planet.

steps.text: Research the solar-system-edge route, build a platform with sustained fuel, ammunition, power, and asteroid processing, depart Aquilo, and survive the full 100,000 km journey to the solar system edge.

achievements.description: Travel 10 000 km towards the shattered planet.
achievements.summary: Travel at least 10,000 km from the solar system edge toward the @loc{shattered planet}.

guide.context: The shattered-planet route opens after Space Age completion and contains increasingly dense asteroids.

steps.text: Depart the solar system edge toward the shattered planet on an armed platform and remain on the route until the distance counter reaches 10,000 km.

achievements.description: Travel 30 000 km towards the shattered planet.
achievements.summary: Travel at least 30,000 km from the solar system edge toward the @loc{shattered planet}.

guide.context: Railguns, rockets, ordinary turrets, and continuous ammunition production are needed as asteroid density rises.

steps.text: Upgrade the shattered-route platform's weapons and ammunition production, depart toward the shattered planet, and survive until the distance counter reaches 30,000 km.

achievements.description: Travel 60 000 km towards the shattered planet.
achievements.summary: Travel at least 60,000 km from the solar system edge toward the @loc{shattered planet}.

guide.context: A ship that comfortably reaches the solar system edge may handle the early shattered route, but 60,000 km demands sustained railgun, rocket, and turret coverage.

steps.text: Strengthen the shattered-route platform for continuous fuel, power, repair, ammunition, and asteroid processing; travel toward the shattered planet until 60,000 km registers.

achievements.description: Kill a big demolisher.
achievements.summary: Kill one big @enemy{demolisher} in a distant Vulcanus territory.

guide.context: Big demolishers occupy distant territories and require late Space Age firepower; the Aquilo railgun is the recommended high-damage option.

steps.text: Research the railgun and weapon upgrades, locate a big demolisher far from the Vulcanus start, target the head or tail, and sustain railgun fire until the big demolisher dies.

achievements.description: Start producing electric power by solar panels.
achievements.summary: Place a @item{solar panel}, connect an electrical load, and let the panel generate electricity.

guide.context: Delay solar-panel placement until Steam all the way has unlocked; solar panels may be crafted earlier without breaking that restriction.

steps.text: After the first rocket launch, place a solar panel in daylight, connect the panel to an electric network with demand, and wait for positive generation.

achievements.description: Start producing electric power by steam engine.
achievements.summary: Connect a fueled @item{boiler} to water and let an attached @item{steam engine} generate electricity.

guide.context: The achievement triggers from produced electrical power, not from merely placing the steam engine.

steps.text: Feed an offshore pump into a boiler, fuel the boiler, connect the steam output to a steam engine, attach an electric load, and wait for generation to begin.

achievements.description: Destroy a cliff.
achievements.summary: Use @item{cliff explosives} to destroy one generated cliff section.

guide.context: Cliff explosives require Explosives research, and a map generated without cliffs offers no target.

steps.text: Research Cliff explosives, craft one charge, aim the charge at a cliff segment, and fire the charge.

achievements.displayName: Today's fish is trout a la creme
achievements.description: Eat a legendary fish.
achievements.summary: Consume one legendary-quality @item{raw fish}.

guide.context: Fish recipes do not accept quality modules, so quality must be raised through recycler upcycling. Fish spoil, making an alert or immediate pickup important.

steps.text: Breed or collect a renewable fish supply, send non-legendary fish through recyclers fitted with quality module 3 units, preserve any upgraded fish through further cycles, and consume the first legendary fish before spoilage.

achievements.description: Travel to planet Aquilo.
achievements.summary: Ride a space platform to @loc{Aquilo} and arrive successfully.

guide.context: Aquilo access depends on technologies from Vulcanus, Fulgora, and Gleba, so the first three planets must supply their science packs.

steps.text: Complete the Aquilo route research, prepare a platform for the longer asteroid route, set Aquilo as the destination, and arrive successfully.

achievements.description: Travel to planet Fulgora.
achievements.summary: Ride a space platform from Nauvis and arrive in @loc{Fulgora} orbit or on the planet.

guide.context: Vulcanus, Fulgora, and Gleba may be visited in any order after building a capable space platform.

steps.text: Prepare a fueled and defended space platform, set Fulgora as the destination, travel to Fulgora, and arrive successfully.

achievements.description: Travel to planet Gleba.
achievements.summary: Ride a space platform from Nauvis and arrive in @loc{Gleba} orbit or on the planet.

guide.context: Vulcanus, Fulgora, and Gleba may be visited in any order after building a capable space platform.

steps.text: Prepare a fueled and defended space platform, set Gleba as the destination, travel to Gleba, and arrive successfully.

achievements.description: Travel to planet Vulcanus.
achievements.summary: Ride a space platform from Nauvis and arrive in @loc{Vulcanus} orbit or on the planet.

guide.context: Vulcanus, Fulgora, and Gleba may be visited in any order after building a capable space platform.

steps.text: Prepare a fueled and defended space platform, set Vulcanus as the destination, travel to Vulcanus, and arrive successfully.

achievements.description: Kill a medium demolisher.
achievements.summary: Kill one medium @enemy{demolisher} in a Vulcanus territory farther from the starting area.

guide.context: Medium demolishers have greater health and regeneration than small demolishers; concentrated artillery and researched weapon damage provide a safer kill.

steps.text: Locate a medium territory, prepare a concentrated artillery battery with ample shells, trigger the demolisher, and maintain head or tail damage until the medium demolisher dies.

achievements.description: Finish the game within 100 hours.
achievements.summary: Reach the @loc{solar system edge} before the save timer reaches 100 hours.

guide.context: A minimal outpost on each planet is sufficient when the route prioritizes required science. For saves started on version 2.0.45 or later, keep pollution and every enemy-related map setting—including enemy-base frequency and size, expansion, starting area, and trees—at default or harder; version 2.0.46 does not apply these new limits retroactively to older saves.

steps.text: On a save that follows the stated version 2.0.45+ map-setting rule, keep moving through Vulcanus, Fulgora, Gleba, Aquilo, and the 100,000 km edge voyage; arrive at the solar system edge before 100:00:00.

achievements.description: Research a technology using promethium science packs.
achievements.summary: Complete any technology whose research cost includes @item{promethium science packs}.

guide.context: Promethium science is postgame research made with promethium asteroid chunks collected on the shattered-planet route.

steps.text: Automate promethium science packs, place the packs in working labs, and finish one technology that consumes that science-pack type.
